description: Elections Commission - Declare that E. M. R. Ekanayaka was elected as the member of the Number 1a Nawamedagama of Dehiaththakandiya Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Dehiaththakandiya Pradeshiya Sabha) due to the death of a member, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the process of nominating and declaring a new member elected, which falls under electoral processes and related administrative matters. This fits the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) for content related to candidate nominations, registrations, and declarations for local authorities.
